text:
sam (people-ops): dropping a tiny, copy/paste-ready toolkit for goal setting & quick feedback asks. meant for busy managers and ICs.

sam (people-ops): Manager goal stub (3 lines):
Goal: Reduce embeddings generation tail latency by 25% for batch workloads.
Anchor metric: 25% reduction in p99 latency; guardrail: no >0.2% increase in failed requests.
Signals: bench results, prod canary telemetry, customer error-rate.

leah: love the guardrail callout. can we add a dependency note?

sam (people-ops): yes 'Dependencies/ hiring: infra-team support required; potential headcount request: infra SWE r1 by Q4'.

sam (people-ops): IC goal micro (one-liner + measures):
Goal: Implement compact KV encoding to cut memory for seq-32 flows by 12%.
Measures: perf delta in CI, PR merged, monitors stable at 3% traffic.

marco: quick self-review template? managers want something scannable.

sam (people-ops): Self-review (bullet list, one-line each):
- What I shipped: one-line + link
- Outcome: metric or user signal (one-line)
- Tradeoffs / surprises: one-line
- Where Im headed next: one priority + why

tina: need a fast peer feedback DM I can paste.

sam (people-ops): Peer ask (DM-ready):
"hey @NAME, quick favor - 2 things i should KEEP and 1 thing i should IMPROVE based on our work on PROJECT. one-line each, really appreciate it."

marco: coaching script for missed goals that isnt too long?

sam (people-ops): Manager micro-coach (4 steps):
1) acknowledge a concrete win to open.
2) show the gap with numbers (baseline vs target).
3) identify blocker(s) and decide on scope or resource changes.
4) agree on 1 action + date for a short follow-up.

leah: calibration tip to prevent metric inflation?

sam (people-ops): calibration note: require 1 quality SLO as a guardrail and label metrics as leading or lagging. ask peers to rate ambition (conservative/stretch) during calibration.

people-ops-bot: heads up - Q4 goal submissions deadline 2026-10-03. submit via https://intranet/reviews/goals

sam (people-ops): i'll add this mini-kit to the handbook and put a printable one-pager in drive. ping me for a slides version. :wave:
